boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented UCSC library study environments, from focused rooms to technology-enabled and outdoor work areas.

cards.title: McHenry Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus library
cards.notes: Start at McHenry for a library-based work session, then choose a reading area or reserve a room when your work calls for more structure.
cards.short_summary: UCSC’s main library building offers several documented study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC Library lists McHenry Library as a library building and offers study-room reservations there.
cards.access_notes: Check the Library’s current building-hours listing before visiting; study rooms are intended for UCSC students.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: Science Hill library
cards.notes: Use this library when your day is centered on Science Hill; reserve a study room online if you need a dedicated shared workspace.
cards.short_summary: A Science Hill library with reservable study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC Library lists the Science & Engineering Library and provides study-room reservations; its renovation includes study and collaboration areas.
cards.access_notes: Check the Library’s current building-hours listing before visiting; its study rooms are intended for UCSC students.

cards.title: McHenry Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: McHenry Library
cards.notes: Reserve a McHenry room for collaborative coursework, and bring a whiteboard marker plan—each listed room has a whiteboard for shared problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: Reservable UCSC student study rooms with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library states that 36 study rooms are in McHenry Library, are for UCSC students to work and study, and each has a whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Library system. Rooms are shared resources for UCSC students and are not general meeting rooms or classrooms.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Library
cards.notes: Book one of the S&E rooms when you need a contained group work setting, then leave it ready for the next student users.
cards.short_summary: A set of 16 reservable study rooms in the Science & Engineering Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library states that 16 study rooms are in the Science & Engineering Library and that the rooms are intended for UCSC students to work and study.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Library system. Follow the Library’s food-and-drink policy and shared-room expectations.

cards.title: Second-Floor Booths
cards.subtitle: McHenry Library, second floor
cards.notes: Set up in the second-floor booths when you want a defined seat for focused reading, drafting, or laptop work inside McHenry.
cards.short_summary: Booth seating documented on McHenry’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2025 UCSC Library feature identifies the booths on McHenry Library’s second floor as a place a UCSC student used to focus.
cards.access_notes: Use during McHenry Library open hours; check the Library’s current hours before travel.

cards.title: Silent Study Room
cards.subtitle: McHenry Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Choose the fourth-floor Silent Study Room for an intentionally quiet library setting; arrive with materials ready so you can settle in quickly.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-work room on McHenry’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2025 UCSC Library feature identifies the Silent Study Room on McHenry Library’s fourth floor as a place used for focus.
cards.access_notes: Use during McHenry Library open hours; check the Library’s current hours before travel.

cards.title: Reading Porches
cards.subtitle: McHenry Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Take portable work to the fourth-floor outdoor reading porches when daylight and an open-air table help you work through a lighter task.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor fourth-floor study seating at McHenry Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC Library documents outdoor reading porches on McHenry Library’s fourth floor as a quiet study environment with chairs and tables.
cards.access_notes: Use during McHenry Library open hours and account for weather; check the Library’s current hours before travel.

cards.title: David Kirk Digital Scholarship Commons
cards.subtitle: McHenry Library, ground floor
cards.notes: Use the Digital Scholarship Commons when course work involves music or film materials, then reserve an audio or video room if one fits the assignment.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor McHenry space with specialized media rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library locates the Digital Scholarship Commons on McHenry’s ground floor and describes its audio and video rooms for music and film-related assignments.
cards.access_notes: Audio and video rooms are specialized for collection use; users of the Adaptive Technology station receive priority.

cards.title: Digital Scholarship Innovation Studio
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Library, lower level
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or experimentation, and use the studio’s peer-supported technology environment to develop it further.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level S&E Library studio for technology-enabled project work.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC Library lists the Digital Scholarship Innovation Studio on the lower level of the Science & Engineering Library; it supports student creation and experimentation.
cards.source_title: Giving to the Library | University Library
cards.access_notes: The Library lists separate studio hours and equipment services; check current availability before visiting.

cards.title: STEM Hub
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Library
cards.notes: Use the STEM Hub’s cubicles or larger table for a collaborative STEM work session, and connect with its advising or tutoring support when needed.
cards.short_summary: A Science & Engineering Library study space paired with student support.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC Library documents the STEM Hub in the Science & Engineering Library, including cubicles and a larger study table for student work.
cards.access_notes: The Hub supports STEM students through partnering UCSC services; confirm current programming and availability before visiting.
